passives.name: Remnants of Prayer
passives.desc: When entering battle and at the end of every 3 rounds, gains 2 stacks of [Lingering Dust] (Genesis DMG Taken -15%, DMG Taken Reduction +25%, up to 2 stacks); loses 1 stack at the end of other rounds.

passives.name: Source of Gold
passives.desc: After being attacked, gains 1 stack of [Stabilize] (when attacked by Mental DMG, DMG Taken Reduction +30%, -1 stack after trigger). Clears all [Stabilize] stacks on the field at the end of the round.

passives.name: Echo of Benediction
passives.desc: At the end of the round, if no [Guide] is present, summons a [Guide] (reduces Reality DEF and Mental DEF of all units by 15% on entry). After casting Ultimate, if no [Herald] is present, summons a [Herald] (shares damage taken by allies; breaking [Afflatus Guard] deducts 20% HP).

passives.name: Ultimate & Control Threats
passives.desc: 1-target attack [Whispers in the Woods] inflicts [Disarm] for 2 rounds; Ultimate [Slumber Beneath the Golden Lake] deals mass DMG and triggers an extra Skill 1 cast.

counterTips: Favor Star or Plant mass-attack carries to stack [Power Burst], strip [Stabilize] stacks with multi-hit attacks, and break [Afflatus Guard] early to burst inside [Afflatus Vulnerable].
At 30M+ thresholds, bring cleanse or [Immunity] support for [Disarm] and [Daze], and avoid unloading peak multipliers while the boss holds [Lingering Dust] at 100M+.

thresholds.desc: [Source of Gold] now grants 2 stacks of [Stabilize] each time the boss is attacked.

Ultimate follow-up attack DMG Multiplier +600%.
After casting Ultimate, gains [Immunity] for 1 round.
When attacked while holding [Lingering Dust], the attacker's DMG Multiplier -500%.

passives.name: Gunpowder Rain
passives.desc: After being attacked, Obscurity -2 (up to 5/round); Stronger Afflatus -3 (up to 2/round); Stronger Afflatus mass attack -2 (up to 6/round); immune to [Control] (-10 Obscurity instead). Reaching 0 Obscurity grants [Witness Round] (up to 4 times).

passives.name: Reinforcement
passives.desc: At the start of the round, summons 2 Believers of Destruction (or 1 Believer + 1 Hound after strengthening). When an ally dies, gains [Resentful Roar]; at 8 stacks, inflicts [Revealed] (DMG Taken Reduction -70%) on self and removes the highest level of [Enhanced Rounds].

passives.name: Trench Cover
passives.desc: When attacked by a non-Stronger Afflatus 1-target attack, DMG Taken Reduction +25%. At the start of the round, gains 1 stack of [Deceptive Facade] (+1 stack when strengthened twice).

counterTips: Deploy Plant or Star mass attackers to shred Obscurity into [Witness Round] while clearing adds fast enough to stack 8 [Resentful Roar], forcing [Revealed] (-70% DMG Taken Reduction) and stripping [Enhanced Rounds].
Avoid non-Stronger 1-target hits and peel off [Deceptive Facade] stacks before unloading major burst skills.

急性猩红症.favoredText: Beast, Spirit, and Intellect Afflatus characters' ATK, Reality DEF, Mental DEF, and Max HP +20%
envRules: [Ally]: After performing a 1-target attack, gains 1 stack of [Enervate] (Incantation Might -10%, stackable, removed after casting an Ultimate; up to 4 times per round).

passives.name: Beneath the Wings of Night
passives.desc: After being attacked, Obscurity -2 (up to 5/round); Stronger Afflatus -3 (up to 2/round); mass attack -2 (up to 8/round); immune to [Control] (-10 Obscurity instead). Reaching 0 Obscurity grants [Witness Round] (up to 4 times).

passives.name: Blood-Borne Transmission
passives.desc: At the start of the round, summons 2 [Bloodthirsty Thralls]. If there are at least 6 stacks of [Blood Drinking] at the start of the round (reduced to 5 stacks when strengthened twice), deploys the [Vampiric Plague] [Array] (boosts Reality DEF and deals 30% Max HP Genesis DMG to all enemies).

counterTips: Favor Beast, Spirit, or Intellect mass attacks and Ultimates to avoid stacking [Enervate] from 1-target casts while accelerating [Witness Round].
Keep [Bloodthirsty Thralls] controlled so [Blood Drinking] stays below threshold and never deploys the [Vampiric Plague] [Array].

超限的囚徒.favoredText: Beast and Intellect Afflatus characters' ATK, Reality DEF, Mental DEF, and Max HP +20%
envRules: [Ally]: Every 3 rounds, gains Ultimate Might +40% for 1 round (align Ultimate burst windows with this cycle).

passives.name: Literary Exchange
passives.desc: After being targeted by an actively cast 1-target non-Ultimate incantation, Obscurity -5; Stronger Afflatus -3; immune to [Control] (-10 Obscurity instead). Reaching 0 Obscurity grants [Witness Round] (up to 4 times).

passives.name: Answer Every Question
passives.desc: When being attacked, the attacker's Incantation Might -30%; when attacked by a 1-target Extra Action, the attacker's Ultimate Might +30%. At the end of the round, inflicts 3 stacks of [Answer] on all enemies (1-target attacks remove 2 stacks; mass attacks remove 1 stack).

passives.name: Limits of Multiple Advisors
passives.desc: At the end of the round, if not in [Witness Round], gains 5 stacks of [Ceremonious] (10/20 stacks when strengthened 1/2 times). After being attacked by a 1-target Ultimate, loses 5 stacks of [Ceremonious].

counterTips: Run Beast or Intellect 1-target Extra Action and 1-target Ultimate squads: cast active 1-target non-Ultimates for [Witness Round], gain +30% Ultimate Might from 1-target Extra Actions, and align bursts with the every-3-round +40% window.
Clear [Answer] with 1-target hits and spend 1-target Ultimates to trim boss [Ceremonious] stacks.

蜕化的残响.favoredText: Mineral and Beast Afflatus characters' ATK, Reality DEF, Mental DEF, and Max HP +20%
envRules: [Ally]: Mental DMG characters gain DMG Bonus +20%. Reality DMG characters gain DMG Bonus -60%.

passives.name: Engulfing Terror
passives.desc: After being attacked, Obscurity -2 (up to 5/round); Stronger Afflatus -3 (up to 2/round); Extra Action attack -3 (up to 6/round); immune to [Control] (-10 Obscurity instead). Reaching 0 Obscurity grants [Witness Round] (up to 4 times).

passives.name: Silken Cocoon
passives.desc: When attacked by a non-Extra Action, Critical Resist Rate +50% and Critical DEF +50%. After casting Ultimate, eliminates existing allies and summons new ones.

passives.name: Metamorphosis
passives.desc: After any ally acts, gains 1 stack of [Breaking Cocoon] (DMG Bonus +2.5%, DMG Taken Reduction +2.5%; 2/3 stacks when strengthened 1/2 times). Ultimate clears all stacks and inflicts [Chaos] for 2 rounds; Skill 1 [Bewilderment] inflicts [Disarm] for 2 rounds on targets afflicted with [Chaos].

counterTips: Commit to Mineral or Beast Mental DMG Extra Action carries to claim +20% Mental DMG, bypass [Silken Cocoon]'s +50% Critical Resist/DEF, and trigger [Witness Round] quickly.
Cleanse or block [Chaos] with [Immunity] right after the boss's Ultimate so Skill 1 [Bewilderment] cannot chain into 2-round [Disarm].

信仰的移位.favoredText: Primal Afflatus (Spirit / Intellect) characters' ATK, Reality DEF, Mental DEF, and Max HP +20%
envRules: [Ally]: Mass attack DMG Bonus +20%; 1-target attack DMG Bonus -60%.

passives.name: Faith Dissociation
passives.desc: After being attacked, Obscurity -2 (up to 5/round); Stronger Afflatus -3 (up to 2/round); actively cast Debuff incantation -5; immune to [Control] (-10 Obscurity instead). Reaching 0 Obscurity grants [Witness Round] (up to 4 times).

passives.name: Consciousness Infection
passives.desc: When being attacked, for each ally present, gains DMG Taken Reduction +30%, Critical Resist Rate +30%, and Critical DEF +30%. When no allies are present, attackers suffer Incantation Might -20%.

passives.name: Heresy Inquisition
passives.desc: Ultimate [Annihilation of Free Will] deals extra Mental DMG per ally present and inflicts [Collapse] (Critical Rate -30%, Critical DMG -30%, DMG Taken Reduction -15%; -1 stack when targeted by a Buff incantation, -3 stacks after casting a Buff incantation).

counterTips: Pair Spirit or Intellect mass attackers with active Debuff casters to sweep adds immediately (removing +30% DMG Reduction and Critical Resist/DEF per add) while rushing [Witness Round].
Cast Buff incantations right after [Annihilation of Free Will] (-3 stacks of [Collapse] on self) to restore Critical stats immediately.

生命的饥谨.battlefield: Guzhu County · Beneath the Plum Tree (3v4)
生命的饥谨.favoredText: Mineral and Spirit Afflatus characters' ATK, Reality DEF, Mental DEF, and Max HP +20%
envRules: [Ally]: For each point of Moxie held, DMG Bonus -5% when attacking (encouraging frequent Ultimate casts rather than hoarding Moxie).

Collector's Edition Rule: Reaching 4M / 10M score grants the boss Critical DEF +30% / +100%. Breaking [Afflatus Guard] into [Afflatus Vulnerable] with Stronger Afflatus attacks ignores this Critical DEF bonus and grants Stronger Afflatus DMG Multiplier +15%.

passives.name: Feed on Wind and Dew
passives.desc: At the start of the round, if allies are present, all enemy units gain 1 stack of [Cloud Veil] (DMG Taken Reduction +10% per stack, up to 5 stacks). Taking 2 Ultimate attacks in a single round removes 3 stacks of [Cloud Veil].

passives.name: Unquenchable Wildfire
passives.desc: When attacked by a target holding a [Shield], the boss gains DMG Taken Reduction +20%. Before casting Ultimate, the boss forces a 1-round [Shield] (300% ATK) onto your team.

passives.name: Spring Breeze Returns & Immortality Devotees
passives.desc: At the end of the round, replenishes up to 2 [Immortality Devotees]. Devotees take +80% Ultimate DMG and rewrite 1 card in your Spelldock each round into [Restlessness] (holding it deducts 10% Current HP).

passives.name: Multi-Hit Ultimate Burst
passives.desc: Skill 2 stacks [Subtle Qi]; the Ultimate triggers extra mass follow-up attacks scaling with [Subtle Qi] stacks and deals +60% DMG to targets below 50% HP, requiring timely healing.

counterTips: Run Mineral or Spirit rapid-Ultimate squads to spend Moxie early and land 2 Ultimates in one round (3 at 100M+) to strip [Cloud Veil] stacks.
Avoid shield-reliant supports that trigger [Unquenchable Wildfire]'s +20% DMG Taken Reduction, play rewritten [Restlessness] cards promptly, and keep HP above 50% with instant heals.

thresholds.desc: When attacked by an Extra Action basic attack, gains Critical Resist Rate +30% and Critical DEF +30%.
At the end of the round, gains Observation Point +1, and Skill 2 grants +2 extra stacks of [Subtle Qi].
Ultimate follow-up attacks deal additional Genesis DMG equal to 15% of the target's Current HP.
Ultimate triggers 3 additional mass attacks.
[Cloud Veil] DMG Taken Reduction rises from +10% to +30% per stack.
[Feed on Wind and Dew] now requires 3 Ultimate attacks in a single round to remove [Cloud Veil].

fbMechanics.name: Stage 1 · Pursuit / Extra Action
envRules: Enemies take Final DMG Taken -30% for the first 4 rounds. Stronger Afflatus attacks reduce [Afflatus Guard]; breaking it deducts a large chunk of HP before [Afflatus Guard] immediately recovers.

Recommended Buffs: [Pursuit Surge] grants 2 [Star Pursuit Points] every 2 rounds starting from Round 2; [Keen Edge] stacks [Lingering Edge] on attack (at 10 stacks transforms into [Razor Sharp]: Incantation Might +60%, Penetration Rate +20%); [Guard Break Boost] grants DMG Bonus +30% after breaking [Afflatus Guard].

passives.name: Tidal Protection (Shared)
passives.desc: Takes 50% less damage from mass attacks, strongly favoring 1-target burst and Extra Action / Pursuit focus fire.

passives.name: Rhythm of the Tides
passives.desc: Switches between [High Tide] (DMG Bonus +30%; casts Rank 1 Skill 1 at end of round) and [Low Tide] (DMG Taken Reduction +20%; casts Rank 1 Skill 2 at end of round) each round.

passives.name: Taunt & Sustain Threats
passives.desc: Hippocampus's [Thumping Fins] grants [Taunt] for 2 rounds and Ultimate [Sea Beast's Philosophy] heals the lowest-HP ally for 25% Max HP plus 1 stack of [Sturdiness]. Charybdis's [High Tide] Ultimate [All-Consuming Maw] deals bonus Reality DMG to targets below 50% HP and inflicts [Bleed] for 2 rounds.

counterTips: Both enemies take 50% less damage from mass attacks via [Tidal Protection] — deploy Pursuit or high-frequency 1-target Extra Action teams to break [Afflatus Guard] early and stack [Keen Edge].
Focus down Hippocampus first to prevent [Taunt] and its 25% HP heal + [Sturdiness], and stay above 50% HP before Charybdis's [High Tide] Ultimate.

fbMechanics.name: Stage 2 · Lingering Glow / Scylla
envRules: Enemies take Final DMG Taken -30% for the first 4 rounds. Stronger Afflatus attacks reduce [Afflatus Guard], triggering heavy percentage HP loss upon break.

Recommended Buffs: [Lingering Glow Might] starts with 300 [Lingering Glow] and grants all allies Incantation Might +10%–45% at 100/200/300/600 thresholds; [Ultimate Feedback] stacks +10% DMG Bonus on Slot 1 per Ultimate cast (up to +60%); [Guard Break Boost] grants DMG Bonus +30% on breaking [Afflatus Guard].

passives.name: Rhythm of the Tides
passives.desc: Switches between [High Tide] (DMG Bonus +30%) and [Low Tide] (DMG Taken Reduction +20%) each round; prepare sustain and cleanse or [Immunity] during [High Tide].

passives.name: High Tide Dual Control
passives.desc: During [High Tide], Scylla's Ultimate [Choking Coil] inflicts [Disarm] for 1 round and Skill 2 [Abyssal Slither] dispels 1 [Pos Status]; Wild Scylla's Ultimate [Strangling Coil] inflicts [Silence] for 1 round.

passives.name: Frontline Targeting
passives.desc: [Guttural Screech] prioritizes the leftmost ally (Slot 1), requiring durable Slot 1 positioning or protective mitigation.

counterTips: Run Lingering Glow or rapid-Ultimate squads with [Lingering Glow Might] and [Ultimate Feedback], placing a protected carry in Slot 1 to absorb [Guttural Screech] while stacking Slot 1 DMG Bonus.
Prepare cleanse or [Immunity] for [High Tide] [Disarm] / [Silence] and buff dispels, and break [Afflatus Guard] early to secure 0–6 round clears.

fbMechanics.name: Stage 3 · Conduit / Golden-Fleeced Ram
envRules: Enemies take Final DMG Taken -30% for the first 4 rounds. Stronger Afflatus attacks reduce [Afflatus Guard], triggering heavy percentage HP loss upon break.

Recommended Buffs: [Sympathetic Resonance] grants all allies ATK +10% if Slot 4 is Mineral, or Spelldock limit +1 if Slot 4 is Star; [Might Unleashed - Mineral] grants Slot 1 Incantation Might +10% and Ultimate Might +10% if Mineral; [Guard Break Boost] grants DMG Bonus +30% on breaking [Afflatus Guard].

passives.name: A Fleece's Duty
passives.desc: Whenever an allied Eclipse Bat retreats, Golden-Fleeced Ram gains Moxie +1 and Critical Rate +15% / Critical DMG +15% for 1 round.

passives.name: Untouchable Golden Fleece & Scorch
passives.desc: Golden-Fleeced Ram's Ultimate [Untouchable Golden Fleece] inflicts 2 stacks of [Scorch] (Healing Taken -20%, end-of-round Genesis DMG, up to 10 stacks; dispel 1 stack when targeted by a Heal, Buff, or Counter incantation). Skill 1 [Glittering Temper] inflicts [Paralyze] (converts to [Daze] at 2 stacks) and Skill 2 [Fluffy Comfort] grants DMG Taken Reduction +30%.

passives.name: Bloodthirsty Nature (Eclipse Bat)
passives.desc: Eclipse Bats gain Leech Rate +30% when attacking below 50% HP, and their Ultimate [Ambush in Endless Night] deals +100% additional Reality DMG to targets afflicted with [Poison].

counterTips: Run Mineral or Star Conduit / Ultimate teams with a Mineral carry in Slot 1 and a Mineral/Star support in Slot 4 for [Might Unleashed - Mineral] and [Sympathetic Resonance], clearing Eclipse Bats together to limit [A Fleece's Duty] Moxie spikes.
Weave Heal, Buff, or Counter incantations to dispel [Scorch], cleanse [Paralyze] before 2 stacks convert into [Daze], and avoid taking Eclipse Bat Ultimates while afflicted with [Poison].

glossary.desc: Beneficial non-stat statuses (such as Immunity, Sturdiness, Rousing Morale, and Cure) counted by buff-scaling mechanics and dispellable unless marked undispellable.
Immune to [Stats Down], [Neg Status], and [Control] statuses while active.
Prevents all [Control] statuses (Daze, Petrify, Nightmare, Freeze, Disarm, Silence, Seal) from taking effect.
When attacked, DMG Taken Reduction +25%; consumes 1 stack after triggering.
Absorbs incoming damage up to its shield value for its duration; normally does not block Genesis DMG unless specified.
Draws enemy targeting priority so eligible single-target attacks lock onto the Taunting unit first.
Grants a continuous Counter stance whose effect triggers automatically when the holder is attacked.
Immediately counterattacks enemies after being attacked; most modern Ripostes count as an Extra Action.
DMG Bonus +50% on the holder's next attack (-1 stack after triggering).
Ultimate Might +3% per stack (up to 100 stacks, undispellable); all stacks are consumed after casting an Ultimate.
DMG Bonus +25% when attacking; consumes 1 stack after triggering.
When attacked by Mental DMG, DMG Taken Reduction +30% (-1 stack after triggering).
At the start of the round, restores HP to the holder based on the caster's ATK.
Harmful non-stat statuses (such as Burn, Poison, Bleed, Scorch, Chaos, and Weakness) tracked by debuff-scaling effects and cleansable unless undispellable.
Healing Taken -15% (unstackable). At round end, deals Genesis DMG equal to 4% of the holder's ATK per stack (up to 30 stacks; halves stacks on trigger; fuels [Lingering Glow]).
Healing Taken -20%. At round end, deals Genesis DMG equal to 10% of the holder's ATK per stack (up to 10 stacks); targeted by a Heal, Buff, or Counter incantation dispels 1 stack.
At the end of the round, takes Genesis DMG scaling with the caster's ATK; multiple independent instances can stack.
After the afflicted unit acts, takes Genesis DMG equal to 100% of the caster's ATK.
Official Global Neg Status (community: Confusion). At 3 stacks, inflicts DMG Bonus Down I for 2 rounds; some bosses combo [Chaos] into [Disarm].
DMG Dealt -25% on the holder's next attack (-1 stack after triggering).
Reduces Healing Taken by 50% for the duration of the effect.
At the end of the round, takes Genesis DMG based on the caster's ATK (stackable).
At the end of the round, loses HP proportional to Current HP (capped by the caster's ATK).
Action-restricting statuses: [Daze], [Petrify], [Nightmare], [Freeze], [Disarm], [Silence], and [Seal]. Witness's Edition bosses convert Control immunity into Obscurity -10.
Hard [Control] status (community: Stun). The afflicted unit cannot take any action while active.
Cannot act; dispelled immediately after taking a Reality DMG attack.
Cannot act; dispelled immediately after taking a Mental DMG attack.
Cannot act; dispelled immediately after taking any attack.
Cannot cast Attack-type incantations while active.
Cannot cast Buff, Debuff, Heal, or Counter-type incantations while active.
Cannot cast Ultimates while active.
At 2 stacks, converts into [Daze] (or extends an existing [Daze] duration by 1 round).
Direct positive stat modifiers (ATK, DEF, Critical Rate/DMG, Incantation/Ultimate Might, DMG Bonus, etc.).
Direct negative stat modifiers (DEF Down, Critical DEF Down, DMG Taken Reduction Down, etc.).
Physical damage mitigated by the target's Reality DEF and boosted by Reality DMG modifiers.
Psychic damage mitigated by the target's Mental DEF and boosted by Mental DMG modifiers.
True damage that ignores Reality DEF, Mental DEF, and most standard shields; cannot critically hit unless explicitly enabled by a skill.
Multiplies the damage dealt by non-Ultimate incantations (including Extra Action attacks classified as basic incantations).
Multiplies the damage dealt by Ultimates and follow-up attacks classified as Ultimate DMG.
Reduces incoming Critical DMG multiplier. In Collector's Edition Mane's Bulletin, bosses gain +30% / +100% Critical DEF at 4M / 10M score unless broken into [Afflatus Vulnerable].
Directly subtracts from the attacker's Critical Rate when calculating whether an attack critically hits.
Ignores the corresponding percentage of the target's Reality DEF or Mental DEF when dealing damage.
Additive damage increase bucket offset directly against the target's DMG Taken Reduction.
Reduces incoming Reality and Mental damage by subtracting from the attacker's DMG Bonus.
Battlefield-wide field effect continuously affecting units on the field; only one [Array] can exist at a time across both allies and enemies (deploying a new one replaces the old).
Personal or team aura effect (such as Pulsing Field or character-specific fields) that persists independently of [Array] and enables Force Field Psychubes.
Denotes environmental rules and battlefield buffs/penalties that apply specifically to your playable arcanist squad.
Ultimate energy resource (standard cap: 5). Reaching max Moxie generates the character's Ultimate card on the next round.
Special secondary resource bar used by select arcanists (e.g., 37, 6, Marcus, Barcarola, Aleph) to trigger follow-ups, rank-ups, or [Impromptu Incantation] Inspiration.
Core resource of the Dynamo archetype (Lucy, Ulrich, Charon, Corvus, Brume, Enigma, Ezra): transferring Dynamo upgrades the [Pulsing Field] (Lv.1–Lv.3) for massive teamwide buffs and bursts.
Team resource accumulated by HP loss and sacrifice (Nautika, Semmelweis, Sentinel, Rubuska, Eternity, Ezra); higher Max Bloodtithe unlocks huge Ultimate and Critical DMG multipliers.

Teamwide bonus incantation fueled by [Inspiration] (generated via Eureka consumption by Barcarola, Aleph, Kiperina, Paper Heron, Voyager, Regulus, Tooth Fairy, Matilda) that fires automatically at action end.
Endgame character upgrade system (unlocked at Insight III Lv.30 for 6-stars / Lv.1 for 5-stars) adding new Epiphany passives and modernizing older arcanists into top meta archetypes.
Accumulates whenever enemies are inflicted with [Burn] or [Halo] (fewer enemies yield faster buildup); powers Lingering Glow teams (Beryl, Marsha, Lorentz Butterfly, Drake, Isolde, Spathodea).
Autonomous magical devices powered by Conduit Energy (Coppélia, Everecho, The Twins, Hedone, Regulus) that activate at the end of the AP Area and repeatedly cast incantations.
Star-focused follow-up archetype introduced in v4.0 (Huntsworn Lilya, Perchta, Euphoria 37): accumulates [Star Pursuit Points] to unleash high-multiplier Pursuit extra actions.
Any action triggered outside normal AP card casts (such as follow-up attacks, Ripostes, Pursuit hits, and Impromptu casts); bypasses active-cast penalties on bosses like Manifestation of Thought.
Resilience gauge on Collector's Edition & Focused Flashback bosses depleted by Stronger Afflatus attacks; breaking it triggers [Afflatus Vulnerable] and heavy percentage HP loss.
Exposed state entered after breaking [Afflatus Guard]; in Collector's Edition, Stronger Afflatus attacks ignore the boss's 4M/10M Critical DEF bonus and gain Stronger Afflatus DMG Multiplier +15%.
Bonus round triggered when a Witness's Edition boss's Obscurity drops to 0 (up to 4 times): enemies cannot take active actions, total round limit increases, and bonus score is awarded.
Eidolon of Avarice stackable buff (up to 2): Genesis DMG Taken -15%, DMG Taken Reduction +25% (at 100M score, also reduces attacker DMG Multiplier by 500%).
Eidolon of Avarice passive: grants 1 stack of [Stabilize] after being attacked (2 stacks at 5M+ score) and clears all [Stabilize] at round end.
Summoned add of Eidolon of Avarice: reduces Reality DEF and Mental DEF of all units on the field by 15% upon entry.
Summoned add of Eidolon of Avarice after Ultimate: shares damage taken by boss allies; breaking its [Afflatus Guard] deducts 20% HP.
Eidolon of Avarice 1-target attack incantation that inflicts [Disarm] for 2 rounds.

Eidolon of Avarice attack skill that at 30M+ score inflicts [Daze] on a random target for 2 rounds.
Summoned adds of Manifestation of Thought: taking mass attacks grants allies Penetration Rate +20%; upon defeat, inflict 10 [Burn] and apply [Linguistic Critique] to the boss.
Beneficial 3-round buff (+30% Critical DMG) granted to all allies when Manifestation of Thought casts Ultimate with no Fragmented Phrases present.
Debuff applied to Manifestation of Thought when Fragmented Phrases are defeated, dealing heavy Genesis DMG at round end (200% base, 50% at 70M+ score).
Manifestation of Thought Ultimate (+400% DMG Multiplier at 50M+ score); heals your team for 60% HP if no boss allies are present.
Coveter of Eternity stackable mitigation (up to 5 stacks; DMG Taken Reduction +10% per stack, +30% at 70M+ score); taking 2 Ultimates in 1 round removes 3 stacks (3 Ultimates at 100M).
Coveter of Eternity core passive governing [Cloud Veil] accumulation and Ultimate-based stack removal.
Summoned adds of Coveter of Eternity (up to 2): take +80% Ultimate DMG and rewrite 1 player card per round into [Restlessness].
Corrupted card rewritten into your Spelldock by Immortality Devotees; keeping it in hand deducts 10% Current HP.
Stackable charge accumulated by Coveter of Eternity's Skill 2; scales the number of extra mass follow-up attacks unleashed during its Ultimate.
The Bullet-Torn Winter stackable buff: Critical Resist Rate +10% and transfers damage taken to allied hounds.
Buff granted to The Bullet-Torn Winter when a Loyal Hound retreats (DMG Taken Reduction +20%, Critical DEF +20%); cleared at round end.
Summoned adds of The Bullet-Torn Winter (2 per round) that share boss damage and grant [Final Loyalty] when defeated.
Progress gauge of The Bullet-Torn Winter: when full, clears existing adds and summons an enhanced [Winter Vanguard] that immediately casts its Ultimate.
Enhanced elite summon deployed when [Frontline] fills, immediately unleashing a high-threat Ultimate.

Insatiable Bloodsucker Type II stackable shell (+10% Critical Resist Rate & +10% DMG Taken Reduction vs. basic incantations per stack, -1 stack when hit; leftover stacks convert to mass [Poison] next round).
Stackable debuff (up to 10 stacks): DMG Bonus -20%, DMG Taken Reduction -10%, Genesis DMG Dealt -20%. Cleanse by casting an Ultimate.
Insatiable Bloodsucker Type II skill that inflicts stacks of [Hemolysis] on player arcanists.
Insatiable Bloodsucker Type II skill that inflicts [Hemolysis] and sustains the boss.
Insatiable Bloodsucker Type II Ultimate: inflicts Reality DEF -40% and Mental DEF -40% on the boss itself for 1 round, opening the primary burst window.
Summoned adds of Insatiable Bloodsucker I/II that feed [Blood Drinking] or grant the boss [Stabilize] stacks.
Undispellable counter on Insatiable Bloodsucker: reaching 6 stacks (5 when strengthened twice) deploys the [Vampiric Plague] [Array].
Enemy [Array] deployed by Insatiable Bloodsucker that boosts Reality DEF and deals 30% Max HP Genesis DMG / Encroaching Blood to all enemies.
Stackable debuff (Incantation Might -10% per stack) applied after 1-target attacks on Insatiable Bloodsucker; cleared after casting an Ultimate.

Undispellable debuff from The Sun's Thrall (up to 5 stacks): Incantation Might -15%, Ultimate Might -15%, Genesis DMG Dealt -15%; attacking while afflicted spreads 1 stack before removing 2 from self.
Glory Days Manifest self-debuff (up to 5 stacks): Reality DEF -5%, Mental DEF -5%, Critical Resist Rate -5% gained at round end if the boss did not act.
Glory Days Manifest stackable buff (up to 10 stacks): Critical DEF +3% gained whenever a boss ally dies.
Undispellable debuff from The Self-Pitying Avenger (up to 5 stacks): deducts 10% Max HP at round end; healed by a Heal incantation reduces duration by 1 round (once per round).
The Self-Pitying Avenger undispellable armor (up to 2 stacks): Critical Resist Rate +40%, Critical DEF +40%, Genesis DMG Taken -40%; clearing all adds strips 1 stack.
Stackable charge gained per [Limbo Form] stack at round start; at 5 stacks, The Self-Pitying Avenger consumes all stacks to perform an additional attack.
Captive of Transcendentality stackable debuff (up to 20 stacks): Incantation Might -5% and Ultimate Might -5% per stack; 1-target attacks remove 2 stacks, mass attacks remove 1 stack.
Captive of Transcendentality Type II debuff: Max HP -20% (up to 4 independently timed stacks), applied per 25% Max HP lost to boss attacks.
1-round effect from Self-Referential Paradox: DMG Bonus -200%, but actively casting an incantation grants Moxie +1.
Captive of Transcendentality Type II Ultimate that inflicts [Speculate] for 1 round.
Distortion of Faith stackable debuff: Critical Rate -30%, Critical DMG -30%, DMG Taken Reduction -15%; -1 stack when targeted by a Buff incantation, -3 stacks after casting one.
Distortion of Faith Type II status: generates a [Be Silent] card at round start; leaving it in the Spelldock at round end Icebounds/rewrites 2 cards.
Special nuisance incantation generated by [Bafflement]; inflicts [Disarm] or disrupts Spelldock cards if mismanaged.
Stacking gauge on Distortion of Faith Type II (+8 to +10 per round); reaching 40 stacks clears all stacks and immediately casts [Chaos and Turmoil].
Heavy mass Mental attack (300%–500% multiplier) unleashed at 40 stacks of [Blind Devotion]; weakened by [Resounding Prayer] stacks.
Stackable debuff (up to 10 stacks, 3 rounds) applied to Distortion of Faith Type II when casting Debuff incantations: DMG Taken Reduction -2% per stack and reduces [Chaos and Turmoil] DMG.
Distortion of Faith Ultimate: deals heavy Mental DMG scaling with surviving boss allies and inflicts [Collapse].
Caterpillar of Destruction stackable mitigation (up to 3 stacks): DMG Taken Reduction +30% per stack (-1 stack when attacked); dispels [Revealed] when acquired.
Major vulnerability debuff (DMG Taken Reduction -70%) that dispels [Deceptive Facade]; triggered on Caterpillar of Destruction at 8 stacks of [Resentful Roar].
Counter gained by Caterpillar of Destruction when adds die; at 8 stacks, inflicts [Revealed] on self and strips the highest level of [Enhanced Rounds].
Tiered boss ammunition (Levels I–IV) empowering Caterpillar of Destruction's attacks; highest-tier rounds are stripped first upon triggering [Revealed].
